# Felucca host sources (vendored)

`eng_formant.c`: an **unmodified** copy of `firmware/src/eng_formant.c` from https://github.com/guysoft/blackbox-fm1 (the BlackBox port of Felucca), branch `blackbox-fm1`, commit `312f1035504a96ba6a36ab042f917e7c558de763` (2026-11-19). It is the "VOICE" engine of the original FM-1 synth (Felucca, https://github.com/hugelton/Felucca): a Klatt cascade formant synthesizer, after D. H. Klatt, JASA 67 (1980), with formant data from Klatt (1980) and Hillenbrand et al., JASA 97 (1995).
Licence: **GPL-3.0-only**, Copyright (C) 2026 Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hugelton Instruments (the SPDX header is kept). OpenPocket is GPL-3.0-only (LICENSE): the same licence. Unlike `third_party/felucca-engines/` (MIT), this file is GPL, and anything built with it is GPL.
`fe_env_tables.h` is generated by `gen_env_tables.py` from the formula in Felucca's `tools/gen_tables.py` (the host's table the engine reads for its TALK morph).
Used by `engine/px_synth_adapter.h` (the CHOIR type). Evaluation and results: `docs/research/synth2/SYNTH2-VOICE-CHOIR.md`.
